probe: PROBE-A part 4: bar parity is not an invariant of a 1-dim HH^1
description: Exact Q(i) verification that the bar involution is a sigma-semilinear algebra automorphism, that [D^bar] = mu.[D] with mu.sigma(mu) = 1, and that Hilbert 90 plus sigma(a) = -a realise BOTH parities on generators of the same one-dimensional class. Hence the bar-parity gate cannot prune a 1-dimensional HH^1.
verification_vehicle: H_3 at q = i, chosen because the argument is uniform in n (it uses only dim HH^1 = 1, sigma(a) = -a, and Hilbert 90 for a quadratic cyclotomic extension) and H_3 is small enough for exact arithmetic. All three hypotheses hold for H_5(zeta_5): dim HH^1 = 1 was computed in part 1, sigma(a) = -a is checked here for zeta_5 directly, and Q(zeta_5)/Q(sqrt 5) is quadratic.
verdict: The bar-parity sub-test of bean qou-jcmw is VACUOUS as posed: parity is a property of a chosen generator, not of a one-dimensional class, and both parities are realised. Scope-(b) for the GATE (invariant cited: Hilbert 90 for K/K^sigma together with sigma(a) = -a). This neither advances nor refutes the c_3 route -- it removes a proposed filter, so the route must be advanced or pruned on other grounds.
